Subject: Request: preemptible safety net + temporary slice for Aurea pilot

Jonas / Laura —

Quick ask: Aurea Health wants to run a 3-week pilot (starting 10/16) that will run multi-model sweeps and latency-sensitive inference for their clinical triage flow. Product wants a short-lived dedicated slice with preemptible safety net behavior to avoid noisy neighbors during peak runs.

What we need from infra: a carved slice (preferably on A100-equivalent) sized for an initial burst of ~8 GPUs, an autoscale waiver so the pool does not evict during scheduled daily sweeps, and a rollback/eviction policy we can promise the customer if capacity becomes constrained. Procurement will also need a term sheet for the temporary reservation.

Attachments: aurora-pilot-capacity-matrix.xlsx (requested sizing), po-term-sheet.pdf (draft PO template)

Can you confirm feasibility and callers for on-call coverage? Need internal alignment by EOD Thursday so we can respond to Aurea's procurement team.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success (Dedicated)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: preemptible safety net + temporary slice for Aurea pilot

Kim — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying questions before I loop infra ops formally:

1) Affinity: do we need strict node affinity (single-slab) or is soft affinity acceptable? Single-slab simplifies cold-starts but is harder to guarantee at scale.
2) Eviction triggers: we should define precise rollback conditions (e.g., sustained 60s p95 > target, or total cluster utilization > 92% for 10m). Do we want automatic fallback to a quantized variant?
3) Timeline: pilot start 10/16 — we will need at least 72 hours to pre-stage models and warm caches.

I attached a short checklist I use for temporary slices. Marcus, can you confirm if an autoscale waiver + preemptible safety net is doable for 8 GPUs for 3 weeks and what monitoring/tracing hooks we should expose to CS/product?

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: preemptible safety net + temporary slice for Aurea pilot

Jonas / Kim —

We can support a temporary carveout but with constraints. Summary of what infra needs and what we can offer: 

- Slice size & hardware: we can reserve 8x A100-equivalent slots for the window 2028-10-16 through 2028-11-06.
- Affinity: recommend soft affinity with placement preference; hard single-slab increases risk of scheduling failures if fragmentation occurs.
- Autoscale waiver: we can gate evictions using a policy that only allows preemption for non-reserved traffic; grant an autoscale exemption for the slice between 02:00-06:00 UTC (the customer's highest throughput window) and allow preemption outside that window.
- Eviction/rollback: propose automatic fallback to quantized model variant + reduced KV cache size if cluster utilization > 90% sustained for 10 minutes. If fallback fails and user-impacting latency > target for 5 consecutive minutes at p95, we execute a controlled drain and notify CS/ops.
- Monitoring: we'll expose token-level latency and pool-utilization metrics to a shared dashboard and create an alert set (p95 latency, queue length, node failures).
- Runbook: infra can own the on-call escalation; Marcus and one additional on-call engineer will be the primary responders.

Open items for product/procurement: confirmation that quantized fallback is acceptable for SLA language and agreement on financial credit if we revert mid-run. Please confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can file the reservation.

Runbook link: https://drive.redwood.company/drive/folders/1AureaPilotPlan
JIRA: INF-4921 (temp-slice-Aurea)

—Marcus Lin
Principal SRE (Serving Runtime)
Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick decisions:

1) Quantized fallback is acceptable for the pilot with a customer-facing note that output may be slightly less precise; we'll bake that into the pilot agreement.
2) Autoscale waiver window OK as proposed (02:00-06:00 UTC). Please record that explicitly in the PO/term sheet.
3) We agree to the eviction/rollback triggers Marcus proposed; CS will handle messaging if we need to drain.

Kimberly — will you get procurement@aureahealth.com the updated PO (attached) and confirm their signature timeline? Sara from Aurea replied separately that finance is aligned if we can guarantee the carveout window. Forwarded her acknowledgement below.
